heroHeadline: Day 798: Fresh Culiacán Shootings Wound Two as Homes in Progreso and Díaz Ordaz Are Riddled with Gunfire
heroSubtitle: 798 days of cartel civil war: on September 28, gunmen shot a 19-year-old windshield cleaner in Culiacán's Ignacio Allende neighborhood and wounded a 33-year-old man at his home in Antonio Nakayama, while residences in Progreso and Díaz Ordaz were fired on. It follows the Montesierra double homicide and a week-long federal offensive that detained 21 people around Mazatlán. Days of open civil war: 798+.
